title: Fellowship Programme with CEE Countries
summary: The DBU awards up to 50 fellowships per year for advanced qualification in all fields of environmental protection and nature conservation. Highly qualified graduates of all disciplines from CEE countries receive funding for a 6–12 months stay at German host institutions.

degree_levels.notes: above-average university degree (Master or equivalent) obtained within the last 5 years; Bachelor's degree is only sufficient if the degree includes admission to a doctorate; Doctoral candidates can apply if the doctoral project is not completed until after the end of the fellowship.

subject_areas.notes: All disciplines are eligible, with an environmental subject of current interest to the home country, the EU or globally.

institutions.notes: German host institutions: universities, research institutes, companies, environmental- and nature protection agencies and authorities, NGOs, associations, etc.

nationality.notes: Citizenship of one of the participating countries: Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, the Czech Republic, Croatia, Estonia, Hungary, Kosovo, Latvia, Lithuania, North Macedonia, Moldova, Montenegro, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia and Ukraine.

residence.notes: Permanent residence in one of the eligible countries at the time of application.

mandatory.text: citizenship of one of the participating countries
permanent residence in one of the eligible countries at the time of application
very good academic qualification (Master's degree, Magister, Diplom; a Bachelor's degree is only sufficient if the degree includes admission to a doctorate)
environmental subject of current interest to the home country, the EU or globally
knowledge of German, verifiable at the latest at the beginning of the programme

funding.description: The fellowship amounts to 1,350 EUR per month. In addition to the fellowship, a monthly allowance of 100 EUR is paid for material and travel expenses (expense allowance). Each fellow is also covered by a health-, accident- and liability insurance. An intensive German language course of several weeks in Osnabrück (Germany) before commencement of the fellowship is also supported and if necessary, assistance is provided in finding a suitable host institution.
